verdict.rationale: An AI model gateway is a plausible capability for a cloud platform, so this axis applies. However, the evidence shows no Railway-provided unified endpoint for accessing hundreds of models. The only related item is Bring Your Own Models, which lets users sign in with ChatGPT or OpenRouter to power Railway's own agent. That is an adjacent agent-configuration feature, not a gateway that builders can call.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can access hundreds of AI models through a single unified gateway endpoint
